title: 11th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/11/1/2025).
Preliminary debate on the Animal Husbandry and Animal Welfare Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Hinnavaru MP Mohamed Abdul Rahman.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: A short Ramadan sitting scheduled to begin the preliminary debate on the government's Animal Husbandry and Animal Welfare Bill.
